notes: Community skins and new game modes: the original suits plus spy rows 7-11 (Lara, Obsidian, Venom, Breacher, Viper) and merc rows 4-5 (Metro Police, Squad Commander), picked under Home > Skins or with the Skins button in the lobby (every player). The host's lobby has Change Mode: Classic, Challenge (25%), Infinite and Blackout (keep the ECC off for 90 seconds to win; the countdown shows in the timer box; Blackout needs a map with a generator ECC). Needs SCDA Launcher 3.22 (it updates itself at start).
